steps.title: Welcome to the night market
steps.text: Customers arrive through the gates on the west edge. They need walkways to reach the stalls.

steps.title: Paint a walkway
steps.text: Drag from the open gate to the plaza to build a path. Each tile costs budget.

steps.title: Stalls serve the crowd
steps.text: Tap a stall to see its queue and service stats. Long queues overflow and cost score.

steps.title: Light and comfort
steps.text: Use the tray to place lanterns (light speeds walking) and awnings (dry shelter in rain).

steps.title: Hourly choices
steps.text: At each hour you pick one of two upgrades: budget, lanterns, bridges, seating, and more.

steps.title: Survive to dawn
steps.text: Keep overflow warnings down until 06:00. The results screen shows how you did.
